prompt_text: What are the best online courses for learning shadow work and spiritual practice?
ai_overview_text:
Several top-rated online courses and programs focus on shadow work and spiritual-psychological integration:
Instructor: James Hollis
Platform: Jung Platform
Details: A 4-class audio/video course ($127) that explores Jungian shadow formation, projection in relationships, and inner conflict resolution to foster personal individuation. Jung Platform
Instructor: Elaina Bianca
Platform: Udemy
Details: A beginner-friendly, lower-cost option featuring a comprehensive 98-page workbook companion, daily practices, trigger identification, and healing modalities like journaling and meditation. Udemy
Instructor: Melanie Stevens
Platform: Udemy
Details: Over 2 hours of video lectures with downloadable journaling prompts, chakra self-care exercises, and vibration-raising meditations. Udemy
Instructor: Sefy Tofan (Healing Waves)
Platform: Insight Timer
Details: A gentle 10-day, short-format daily audio course focusing on somatic body awareness, inner child healing, and relationship projections. Insight Timer
Instructor: Zachary Phillips
Platform: Zachary Phillips Website
Details: A free, self-paced 12-week course that combines mindfulness, journaling, and inner child work to process unconscious patterns.
Instructors: Cindy Lou Golin and Diane Musho Hamilton
Platform: Real Life Programs / Integral Institute
Details: A 3-day experiential online workshop designed to help shed outdated belief systems through integral shadow practice. Real Life Programs
Platform: Sounds True
Details: Offers multi-tiered intermediate and advanced programs bridging depth psychology, mindfulness, archetypes, and spiritual integration. Sounds True
Are you looking for a beginner-friendly daily practice, an in-depth Jungian/psychological approach, or a course tailored for coaching and practitioner certification?
